title: Compatible affine neighbourhoods for closed-integral pinching
statement: Let $X,T,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $j:Z\to T$ be an integral morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Assume that for every $t\in T$ the subset $i(j^{-1}(\{t\}))$ is contained in some affine open of $X$. Then for every $t\in T$ there are affine open subschemes $U\subseteq X$ and $V\subseteq T$ [def-weil-open-immersion] with $t\in V$ and $i^{-1}(U)=j^{-1}(V)$ as open subschemes of $Z$.

proof.text: Fix $t\in T$. Choose an affine open $U_0\subseteq X$ containing $i(j^{-1}\{t\})$, as in the hypothesis, and set $\Omega_0=i^{-1}(U_0)$. The affine description in [def-weil-closed-immersion] makes $\Omega_0$ affine and $\Gamma(U_0,\mathcal O_X)\to\Gamma(\Omega_0,\mathcal O_Z)$ surjective. By [pqf-lem-integral-univclosed], $j$ is universally closed, hence closed. Thus $H_0=T\setminus j(Z\setminus\Omega_0)$ is an open neighbourhood of $t$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis] to choose an affine $t\in V_0\subseteq H_0$. By the definition of $H_0$, $j^{-1}(V_0)\subseteq\Omega_0$.

source.place: Tag 0ECJ, lemma-prepare-pushout-along-closed-immersion-and-integral, first paragraph, first shrinking of Y

proof.text: Form the scheme-theoretic fibre $Z_t=Z\times_T\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ of [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Its image in $Z$ is exactly $j^{-1}\{t\}$. By [lem-sbc-integral-morphism-base-change] its structure map to $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ is integral. By [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], $Z_t=\operatorname{Spec}A_t$ for a commutative algebra $A_t$ integral over the field $\kappa(t)$. The fibre map has image in $j^{-1}(V_0)\subseteq\Omega_0$, so restricts to a morphism into that open subscheme; here restriction means the factorization through the open subspace with the restricted structure sheaf [def-weil-open-immersion].

source.place: Tag 0ECJ, lemma-prepare-pushout-along-closed-immersion-and-integral, first paragraph, fibre integral over a field

proof.text: Write $\Omega_0=\operatorname{Spec}B_0$. By [def-weil-affine-spectrum] the map $Z_t\to\Omega_0$ is induced by a ring map $B_0\to A_t$. Apply [lem-sfb-algebraic-field-image-principal-neighbourhood] to the open subset $j^{-1}(V_0)$ of $\Omega_0$. It gives $\overline f_0\in B_0$ with $j^{-1}\{t\}\subseteq D_{\Omega_0}(\overline f_0)\subseteq j^{-1}(V_0)$. Lift $\overline f_0$ to $f_0\in\Gamma(U_0,\mathcal O_X)$ by [def-weil-closed-immersion], and put $U_1=D_{U_0}(f_0)$. This is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-open-immersion]. Since the affine spectrum map contracts primes, $i^{-1}(U_1)=D_{\Omega_0}(\overline f_0)$: a prime omits $\overline f_0$ exactly when its inverse-image prime omits $f_0$. Thus, writing $\Omega_1=i^{-1}(U_1)$, we have $j^{-1}\{t\}\subseteq\Omega_1\subseteq j^{-1}(V_0)$.

source.place: Tag 0ECJ, lemma-prepare-pushout-along-closed-immersion-and-integral, first paragraph, use of Limits Tag 0E21 and lifting the first function

proof.text: The closedness of $j$, again from [pqf-lem-integral-univclosed], shows that $H_1=V_0\setminus j(Z\setminus\Omega_1)$ is open in the affine scheme $V_0$. It contains $t$, since the whole fibre over $t$ lies in $\Omega_1$. Use the canonical morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)\to V_0$ of [def-pc-scheme-fibre]; its image is $\{t\}$. Apply [lem-sfb-algebraic-field-image-principal-neighbourhood] with the field algebra $A=k=\kappa(t)$ and this map to obtain $g\in\Gamma(V_0,\mathcal O_T)$ such that $t\in V=D_{V_0}(g)\subseteq H_1$. The principal open $V$ is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-open-immersion]. From $V\subseteq H_1$ it follows that $j^{-1}(V)\subseteq\Omega_1$.

source.place: Tag 0ECJ, lemma-prepare-pushout-along-closed-immersion-and-integral, second paragraph, choice of g with saturated preimage in the shrunken X open

proof.text: Since $\Omega_1\subseteq j^{-1}(V_0)$, pull $g$ back along $j|_{\Omega_1}:\Omega_1\to V_0$ to a section $\overline f_1\in\Gamma(\Omega_1,\mathcal O_Z)$. Apply the affine description in [def-weil-closed-immersion] now to the affine open $U_1\subseteq X$ to lift it to $f_1\in\Gamma(U_1,\mathcal O_X)$. Set $U=D_{U_1}(f_1)$, which is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-open-immersion]. Contraction of primes for the spectrum maps [def-weil-affine-spectrum] gives $i^{-1}(U)=D_{\Omega_1}(\overline f_1)=\Omega_1\cap j^{-1}(D_{V_0}(g))$. Because $j^{-1}(V)\subseteq\Omega_1$, this is $j^{-1}(V)$. Equal open subsets carry the same restricted structure sheaf [def-weil-open-immersion], so this is equality as open subschemes of $Z$. Together with $t\in V$, these $U,V$ prove the claim.
